sources.title: Trump administration to deport 150 Afghan refugees to Afghanistan via Pakistan
Trump administration plans to deport some Afghan immigrants to Afghanistan

en.title: Trump Administration Plans to Deport 150 Afghan Immigrants to Afghanistan
en.dek: The U.S. administration announced plans to deport more than 150 Afghan immigrants, with the first flight scheduled for November 2, Trump said the drive aims to improve domestic security.
facts: Trump administration plans to deport more than 150 Afghan immigrants to Afghanistan
First flight expected as early as November 2
Administration detained dozens of Afghan immigrants in Louisiana
Pakistan has expelled over two million Afghan nationals to Afghanistan since 2023
body: The Trump administration announced plans to deport more than 150 Afghan immigrants to Afghanistan. The announcement came after the administration detained dozens of Afghan immigrants in Louisiana, according to the Straits Times. The first flight is expected to depart as early as November 2, the newspaper reported.

Shawn VanDiver, head of AfghanEvac, said many facing removal fled Afghanistan after the 2021 Taliban takeover and U.S. withdrawal. He added that some facing deportation are brothers and sons of men who served alongside U.S. forces, families the Taliban already has every reason to target. VanDiver urged Congress to pass legislation granting Afghans in the U.S. temporary protected status to protect them from deportation.

Rights advocates said the crackdown violates due process and free speech, creating an unsafe environment for minorities. The Homeland Security Department said it would not confirm future removal operations, citing operational security. The administration cannot directly arrange deportations to Afghanistan because it lacks diplomatic ties with the Taliban.

The Times of India headline noted the plan to deport 150 Afghan refugees via Pakistan, a move that follows Pakistan's expulsion of over two million Afghan nationals to Afghanistan since 2023, Reuters reported. The New York Times reported the deportation as one of the largest single expulsions of Afghans.
en.context: The U.S. withdrew troops from Afghanistan in 2021, after which the Taliban took control. The Trump administration has no diplomatic ties with the Taliban, limiting its ability to arrange deportations.
